label: About
title: About Three Grapes in One Loop
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @jala_gram: gm 11-12-26. Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Three Grapes in One Loop: Pastel grape-lasso drift: a wide horizontal frieze of soft airbrushed lavender clouds, chalky ultramarine crayon bars and dragged mustard blur floating on flat dusty-rose ground, seen flat-on like a scanned painting with generous pink margins. One ultramarine crayon band sweeps the full width, fading into hot pink;... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Loose graphite pencil lasso encircling three glossy grape clusters.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
